question: Drug the choice for hyperthyroidism in first trimester of pregnancy is
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Propylthiouracil" -> "preferred for hyperthyroidism treatment in first trimester" -> "lower risk of teratogenic effects compared to Methimazole" -> "safe for developing fetus" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Methimazole" -> "used for hyperthyroidism" -> "higher teratogenic risks in first trimester compared to Propylthiouracil" -> "not recommended in first trimester" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Carbimazole" -> "metabolized to Methimazole" -> "similar teratogenic risks as Methimazole" -> "not preferred in first trimester" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Perchlorate" -> "used to block iodine uptake" -> "less effective and less studied for managing hyperthyroidism in pregnancy" -> "not a first-line treatment" -> 80%
analysis: Propylthiouracil (PTU) is recommended for the treatment of hyperthyroidism in the first trimester of pregnancy due to its lower risk of teratogenic effects compared to Methimazole and Carbimazole. Perchlorate is less commonly used and not the first-line treatment for this condition in pregnancy.
